gloss: to bend back; to warp; to arch

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {反|そ}らしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to bend back; to arch; to warp
definitions.explanation: To cause something to curve or bend backward. Used for the body, back, and physical objects.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}を{後|うし}ろに{反|そ}らしてストレッチした。
examples.english: I stretched by bending my body backward.

examples.japanese: {胸|むね}を{反|そ}らして{堂々|どうどう}と{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: He walked proudly with his chest puffed out.

examples.japanese: {湿気|しっけ}で{板|いた}が{反|そ}ってしまったので、{重|おも}しを{載|の}せて{反|そ}らないようにした。
examples.english: The board warped from humidity, so I put a weight on it to keep it from bending.

notes:
The transitive form of {反|そ}る (to warp, to bend back). Most commonly used for arching the body or back. Also used for physical objects that bend or warp.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背中|せなか}を{反|そ}らす: to arch one's back
- {体|からだ}を{反|そ}らす: to bend one's body back
- {胸|むね}を{反|そ}らす: to puff out one's chest (with pride)
- {腰|こし}を{反|そ}らす: to arch one's lower back

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The intransitive counterpart is {反|そ}る (to warp, to curve back). Note: the homophone {逸|そ}らす means "to avert" (e.g., {目|め}を{逸|そ}らす — to avert one's eyes) and is a different word.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {反|そ}る: to warp, to bend back (intransitive)
- {曲|ま}げる: to bend (more general, any direction)
- {逸|そ}らす: to avert, to divert (different meaning despite identical pronunciation)
